members.evidence: Pinned. Google: "Adobe will release it as Source Han Sans" (Google Developers Blog, "Noto: A CJK Font That is Complete, Beautiful and Right for Your Language and Region", Xiangye Xiao, Stuart Gill and Jungshik Shin, 2014-07-15, <https://developers.googleblog.com/en/noto-a-cjk-font-that-is-complete-beautiful-and-right-for-your-language-and-region/>, read 2026-11-16).

The same design under Adobe's name; Google: "Adobe will release it as Source Han Sans" (Google Developers Blog, "Noto: A CJK Font That is Complete, Beautiful and Right for Your Language and Region", Xiangye Xiao, Stuart Gill and Jungshik Shin, 2014-07-15, <https://developers.googleblog.com/en/noto-a-cjk-font-that-is-complete-beautiful-and-right-for-your-language-and-region/>, read 2026-11-16).

The same contours and points as Noto Sans CJK JP at `wght` 400 in all 8 glyphs compared (Measured 2026-11-16 with fontTools and Pillow on 社永東國示鬱龍飛: contours and points at 1000 units per em, and IoU of the glyphs rendered at 96 px and scaled to a common box; GenZui Serif 0.114 and GenZui Sans 0.105 (`GenZuiSans-Regular.woff2` of ids-input)); its README says "Japanese sans-serif on Noto Sans JP" (mkpoli/GenZui README at 96aa3a0 (2026-11-07), <https://github.com/mkpoli/GenZui>, read 2026-11-16).

Built on Genshin Gothic Regular (Sukima Gothic's BOOTH page (shop oppekebekkanko), ver11.41 of 2026-10-03, <https://booth.pm/ja/items/2117070>, read 2026-11-16; the page states the base but not how the added kanji were made), which is Source Han Sans 1.002 converted to TrueType with M+ glyphs for what it lacks (自家製フォント工房, 源真ゴシック page, <http://jikasei.me/font/genshin/>, read 2026-11-16 over HTTP (its HTTPS certificate names another host)). Its own outlines were not compared: its download requires a signed-in BOOTH account. Its membership rests on its distribution page and is checked by the same comparison when it is pinned.

Pinned. Its README calls it a supplement to Source Han Sans in Mainland forms and leaves the characters both cover to Source Han Sans: "如需显示基本区和扩展 A 区的表意文字，直接使用思源黑体即可。本项目中所包含的零星的基本区和扩展 A 区的表意文字均为在 Unicode 内有字形改动或者不符合本项目宗旨的表意文字" (for the URO and Extension A use Source Han Sans; the few such ideographs here are ones whose glyph was changed), and warns that in some characters the joins between components look stiff ("部分汉字的部件拼接会很生硬") (Plangothic Project README, `main`, <https://github.com/Fitzgerald-Porthmouth-Koenigsegg/Plangothic-Project>, read 2026-11-16). Where both draw a character, the outlines differ: other point counts, box-normalised IoU 0.66–0.91 against Noto Sans CJK SC (Measured 2026-11-16 with fontTools and Pillow on twelve characters drawn by both Plangothic P1 and Noto Sans CJK SC, chosen with seed 1). Its own drawing in Source Han Sans's style: a separate design.
Pinned with P1, from the same project and release (Plangothic Project README, `main`, <https://github.com/Fitzgerald-Porthmouth-Koenigsegg/Plangothic-Project>, read 2026-11-16).

Pinned. Ken Lunde: "all further references to Source Han Serif or Source Han Sans will apply to Noto Serif CJK" (Ken Lunde, "Source Han Serif / Noto Serif CJK History & Development", CJK Type blog, 2017-04-03, <https://ccjktype.fonts.adobe.com/2017/04/source-han-serif-history-development.html>, read 2026-11-16).

The same design under Adobe's name; Ken Lunde: "all further references to Source Han Serif or Source Han Sans will apply to Noto Serif CJK" (Ken Lunde, "Source Han Serif / Noto Serif CJK History & Development", CJK Type blog, 2017-04-03, <https://ccjktype.fonts.adobe.com/2017/04/source-han-serif-history-development.html>, read 2026-11-16).

The same contours and points as Noto Serif CJK JP at `wght` 400 in all 8 glyphs compared (Measured 2026-11-16 with fontTools and Pillow on 社永東國示鬱龍飛: contours and points at 1000 units per em, and IoU of the glyphs rendered at 96 px and scaled to a common box; GenZui Serif 0.114 and GenZui Sans 0.105 (`GenZuiSans-Regular.woff2` of ids-input)); its README says "Japanese serif on Noto Serif JP" (mkpoli/GenZui README at 96aa3a0 (2026-11-07), <https://github.com/mkpoli/GenZui>, read 2026-11-16).

GlyphWiki's glyphs drawn by the KAGE engine from the dump read at build time (GlyphWiki, <https://glyphwiki.org/>, its dump <https://glyphwiki.org/dump.tar.gz> (114,464,920 bytes, last modified 2026-11-15 17:01 GMT when checked on 2026-11-16), and the KAGE engine, <https://github.com/kamichikoichi/kage-engine>). Not pinned: the font row `glyphwiki@<date>` is written when the dump is fetched.

A font of the same drawing, built from GlyphWiki by KAGE (Koichi Kamichi, Jigmo page <https://kamichikoichi.github.io/jigmo/> and `README.txt` in `Jigmo-20250912.zip` (SHA-256 `5744c738…`), read 2026-11-16); it is not read, since the dump is newer and keeps strokes and divisions.

IPA's MJ glyph set, IPA Font License (文字情報技術促進協議会, IPAmj明朝フォント, <https://moji.or.jp/mojikiban/font/>, read 2026-11-16; `ipamjm00601.zip` (SHA-256 `35494e0f…`), name table "Copyright(c) Information-technology Promotion Agency, Japan (IPA), 2011-2019", version 006.01). Compared with GlyphWiki's drawing (as Jigmo 20250912 renders it), it has other contours (社 64 against 86 points) and a box-normalised IoU of 0.38–0.65, no closer than that drawing against Noto Serif CJK JP (0.41–0.58) (Measured 2026-11-16 with fontTools and Pillow on 社永東國示鬱龍飛, as above): a separate design. Not pinned.

Pinned. BabelStone Han merges Arphic's AR PL Mingti2L Big5 and AR PL SungtiL GB; the PUA face holds what was moved out of it (Andrew West, BabelStone Han, <https://www.babelstone.co.uk/Fonts/Han.html>, read 2026-11-16); its copyright line names Arphic and Andrew West.
